item.title: Broadridge Blockchain Repo Platform Hits $8 Trillion in July
item.summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions’ blockchain-based repo platform processed about $8 trillion in transactions during July, highlighting the growing use of distributed ledger technology in institutional financing and collateral management. Average daily volume on the Distributed Ledger Repo platform, known as DLR, reached $365 billion during the month, representing a 28% increase from a year earlier.
